title:
The Way My Mother
Talked to Plants

es: En The way my mother talked to plants la artista ha filmado a su madre en casa y con amigos, (siendo éstos humanos y no humanos), para reflexionar sobre los cuidado entre especies.
en: In The way my mother talked to plants the artist has filmed her mother at home and with friends, (those being human and non-human), to reflect on interspecies care.
ca: A The way my mother talked to plants, l’artista ha filmat la seva mare a casa i amb amics (tant humans com no humans) per reflexionar sobre les cures entre espècies.
